Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph 31 JUL 2019 OPINION NO. 43 MS. JOSIE M. MONTES MLGOO Loboc, Bohol Dear Ms. Montes: This is in reference to your letteri dated 28 January 2019 to Dir. Leocadio T. Trovela of DILG Region VII which was indorsed to this level, stating that SK Chairperson Taldo of Barangay Agape, Loboc, Bohol was arrested during the buy-bust operation for the alleged sale of illegal drugs on 25 January 2019. Hence, you are inquiring on the following: 1. Can the First Kagawad of the SK Council assume the role as Acting SK Chairman? 2. Can the First Kagawad, as an Acting SK Chairman, receive an honorarium as well as other benefits and privileges duly accorded to an SK Chairman? Relative to the first query, may we invite you to the provisions or RA 10742 otherwise known as the SK Reform Law of 2015 and its Implementing Rules and Regulation (IRR) which provide: SEC. 19. Succession and Filling up of Vacancies. - (a) In case a Sangguniang Kabataan chairperson refuses to assume office, fails to qualify, voluntarily resigns, dies, is permanently incapacitated, is removed from office, the Sangguniang Kabataan member who obtained the highest number of votes in he lecti n •rnme iat / e in hall m h ffic the chairperso.n for the unexpired portion of his Qr her term: IQ case said member refuses to assume the position or fails to qualify, the Sanqquniang Kaé@taan member obtaining the next highest number of votes shall assume the position Qf the chairperson for the unexpired portion of the term. 1 Received by LLLS on 2 April 2019 Page 1 of 3

xxx (c) Al/ other vacancies in the office of the Sangguniang Kabataan shall be filled in accordance with the immediately preceding provision. Section 19 of the IRR xxx (d) Vacancies that are temporary in nature due to physical or legal reasons such as, but not limited to, leave of absence and travel abroad, shall be filled up in accordance with the following: (1) xxx (2) if vacancy is more than a three-day period, the next SK member who obtained the highest number of votes in the election immediately preceding, shall assume the office of the chairperson on the fourth day. In view of the foregoing legal bases, since the SK member who obtained the highest number of votes shall succeed in the Office of SK Chairperson and that the vacancy is only temporary, the said SK Member shall succeed in an acting capacity only, i.e Acting Sangguniang Kabataan Chairperson. In your second query, Section 16 (b) of RA 10742 provides that the Sangguniang Kabataan Chairperson shall have the same privileges enjoyed by other Sangguniang Barangay officials subject to such requirements and limitations provided by the same law. These privileges can also be extended to the acting SK Chairperson as he/she is considered incumbent to said position, though temporary. Under the Local Government Code, honorarium is one of the privileges of the barangay officials, viz: Section 393. Benefits of Barangay Officials. - ffiil incluin aran a t n ran n the lupong tagapamayapa, shall receive honqraria, allowances, and such other emoluments as may be authorized by law or barangay, municipal or city ordinance in accordance with the provisions of this Code, but in no case shall it be less than One thousand pesos (PI,OOO.OO) per month for the punong barangay and Six hundred pesos (P600.00) per month for the sangguniang barangay members, barangay treasurer, and barangay secretary: Provided, however, That the annual appropriations for personal services shall be subject Page 2 of 3

to the budgetary limitations prescribed under Title Five, Book II of this Code; Moreover, Honorarium, as defined by the Government Accounting and Auditing Manual (GAAM), is that remuneration given to public official for services actually rendered.2 (Emphasis ours) Therefore, it can be gleaned from the discussions above that barangay officials, including SK Chairperson are entitled to honorarium (not salary), and which can also be extended to the Acting SK Chairperson. Hence, this Department opines in affirmative. Thus, if the said Official was present in the sangguniang barangay sessions and had rendered actual services as Acting SK Chairperson and ex-officio member of the Sangguniang Barangay, certainly, he will be entitled to an honorarium. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECR ARY: RTIN B. No Undersecretary Copy furnished: Dir. Leocadio T.
